days.title: Glacial Passes and Iconic Spires
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Dente del Gigante
stops.detail: The Dente del Gigante (4,014 m) is one of the most famous peaks.

stops.name: Aiguille Noire de Peuterey
stops.detail: The Aiguille Noire de Peuterey (3,773 m) is one of the symbols of Mont Blanc on the Italian side: it rises directly from the meadows of Val Veny for 2,200 m of elevation gain; it is the most important peak of the great Peuterey ridge.

days.title: Massive Summits and Triple Borders
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Dôme du Goûter
stops.detail: If the summit part of the Grandes Jorasses is bristling with peaks, that of the Dôme du Goûter is completely flat and is the most extensive in all the Alps.

stops.name: Grandes Jorasses
stops.detail: The Grandes Jorasses (3,825 m): on its summit part, about 1 km long, it groups a sequence of six points, five of which exceed 4,000 m.

stops.name: Mont Dolent
stops.detail: Mont Dolent (3,820 m) is a pyramidal peak; curiously its summit is the meeting point of the borders of Italy, Switzerland and France.

stops.name: Guglie di Chamonix
stops.detail: The Aiguilles de Chamonix (between 3,000 and 3,842 m) dominate the Chamonix valley and represent one of the most famous landscapes of the French Alps.
